result.analyst_notes: Mixes factual description with aspirational language. Leads with patients and science, using first-person plural 'we' and absolute phrasing such as 'at the center of everything we do'. Commitments to health equity and ecosystem building are hedged ('strive', 'aspire'). Shared values are listed without elaboration. Safety is absent.
